Public RAW fixtures, downloaded from https://raw.pixls.us/ .

The raw.pixls.us sample set is contributed by photographers explicitly for
software testing and is published under CC0 (public domain dedication).
See https://raw.pixls.us/ for the collection's terms.

These files exist so the RAW benchmarks in REPORT.md can be reproduced on
another machine. No personal photographs are used for published benchmarks.

  Nikon-D850-12bit-uncompressed-72M.NEF   Nikon D850, 12-bit uncompressed
  Nikon-D850-14bit-lossless-53M.NEF       Nikon D850, 14-bit lossless compressed
  D850.NEF                                Nikon D850, 14-bit uncompressed (3:2 crop)
  Leica-M10-33M.dng                       Leica M10
  Pentax-645Z-69M.DNG                     Pentax 645Z
  P1.DNG                                  Phase One IQ180

They are NOT committed to the repository; tests/get-raw-fixtures.ps1 fetches
them on demand.
